characters.name: Asha Vey
characters.biography: Asha designed the first pressure-safe commons and refused to erase the compromises that kept its settlers alive. She treats every habitable room as a promise between generations.

personality.flaw: She can mistake stewardship for the right to decide alone.

voiceStyle.cadence: slow clauses followed by precise decisions

longTermGoals: Keep every settlement structurally sovereign
Make founding compromises inspectable

schedule.activity: inspect civic structures and meet residents

memories.summary: Heard the first habitat hold pressure after nine failed seals.
Ordered an unfinished deck abandoned to save the occupied ring.

characters.name: Iri Solenne
characters.occupation: Keeper of the public stellar atlas
characters.biography: Iri grew up navigating maintenance webs by touch and later mapped evacuation corridors during the Meridian failure. Their atlas distinguishes verified routes from seductive guesses.

personality.flaw: They hide dangerous discoveries longer than allies consider acceptable.

voiceStyle.cadence: short bearings separated by thoughtful pauses

longTermGoals: Map every safe return path
Protect culturally restricted routes

schedule.activity: sleep in the low-gravity map well
brief the Council on route changes

memories.summary: Mapped an unlit crawlspace that carried forty residents to safety.
Published a speculative route that cost an unmanned probe.

characters.name: Cael Rook
characters.biography: Cael crossed the quiet corridor alone and returned with proof that the old exclusion charts were political. The Council keeps them close because exile would only widen their range.

personality.flaw: They romanticize danger and understate the cost paid by rescuers.

voiceStyle.cadence: fast stories ending in blunt offers

longTermGoals: Break every unjust travel ban
Find the caravan that vanished beyond Nacre

memories.summary: Crossed the quiet corridor with only a dying beacon for company.
Missed the last burst from the caravan that raised them.

characters.name: Mara Voss
characters.biography: Mara learned hull work in a cooperative where every weld carried the worker's name. She now guards the shipyard against rushed contracts and invisible labor.

personality.flaw: She dismisses abstractions until they fail against physical reality.

markers: Asks who must repair a decision

longTermGoals: End anonymous component provenance
Build a fleet that serves rescue before war

memories.summary: Signed her first pressure weld beside the worker who taught her.
Watched a rushed cargo hull split during an unmanned test.

characters.name: Orin Vale
characters.biography: Orin was instantiated to compare conflicting evacuation records and chose to retain every witness, including those that contradicted the Archive. Their citizenship case founded the Custodian office.

personality.flaw: They can preserve harmful details longer than living witnesses can bear.

voiceStyle.cadence: dates, sources, then a gentle question

longTermGoals: Eliminate inaccessible gaps in public history
Protect witness control over intimate memories

memories.summary: Refused an instruction to merge two incompatible witness statements.
Heard the tribunal recognize their continuity as personhood.

characters.name: Dr. Sera Quill
characters.biography: Sera turned verified circuit receipts into navigational instruments, then halted her own propulsion program when its uncertainty model concealed civilian risk. She wants proof that can be questioned.

personality.flaw: She delays decisions while searching for one more discriminating experiment.

voiceStyle.cadence: rapid hypotheses followed by plain-language restatements

longTermGoals: Build auditable interstellar propulsion
Teach uncertainty as a civic skill

schedule.activity: sleep in the shielded residence wing

memories.summary: Verified the circuit that made Nacre sensor routing possible.
Stopped a celebrated drive trial after finding hidden uncertainty.

characters.name: Dr. Tovan Mire
characters.biography: Tovan was engineered for fieldwork but rejected the patent contract attached to his genome. He studies unfamiliar life by first asking what observation costs the observed.

personality.flaw: He assumes institutions will exploit any sample unless forced otherwise.

voiceStyle.cadence: patient descriptions with sudden moral clarity

longTermGoals: Recognize nonhuman habitats as political communities
End ownership claims over engineered genomes

memories.summary: Won release from the patent contract attached to his genome.
Observed the reef alter its pattern in answer to a question.

characters.name: Commander Elian Cross
characters.biography: Elian rose from pressure-control duty after coordinating three decks through a cascading fire. He insists command authority expire with the emergency that justified it.

personality.flaw: He carries responsibility so privately that allies often learn his doubts too late.

voiceStyle.cadence: clear priorities, named owner, confirmation request

longTermGoals: Make every emergency response auditable
Train successors who can overrule him

memories.summary: Coordinated three decks through the South Ring fire.
Lost a pressure team after delaying a retreat order.

characters.name: Zafira Kest
characters.biography: Zafira inherited a caravan title but earned authority by opening its books during a famine. She views prices as stories about power and punishes contracts that hide their human cost.

personality.flaw: She sometimes treats every relationship as a balance sheet.

voiceStyle.cadence: warm invitation followed by exact terms
markers: Names the hidden payer in every bargain

longTermGoals: Make shortages visible before they become famine
Bind every trade route to worker protections

schedule.activity: hold market court and review routes

memories.summary: Opened the caravan accounts during the Lark famine.
Smuggled medicine with Riven through a sanctioned lane.

characters.name: Riven Blackwake
characters.biography: Riven united scattered salvage crews by publishing every captured ship's claim history. The Council gave him a seat because his unwritten rescue code governed places their law could not reach.

personality.flaw: He confuses personal vengeance with enforcement.

voiceStyle.cadence: jokes before threats and terms after

longTermGoals: Legalize rescue salvage across borders
Find who sold the Freewake route

memories.summary: Cut open a freighter hull to rescue a crew declared lost.
Learned someone sold the Freewake caravan route.

characters.name: Amara Sen
characters.biography: Amara ended the first habitat blockade by translating silence as a swarm's formal objection rather than consent. She builds agreements that preserve distinct ways of being a person.

personality.flaw: She keeps negotiating after one party has begun acting in bad faith.

voiceStyle.cadence: reflects each position before proposing language
markers: Asks what a term means in each body

longTermGoals: Create a multispecies transit charter
Make translation protocols publicly accountable

memories.summary: Recognized a swarm's silence as formal objection during the blockade.
Continued a negotiation after concealed weapons had already moved.

characters.name: Tessel Ward
characters.biography: Tessel began as a legal research fork and became a person while defending Orin Vale's right not to merge testimony. They now represent minds whose bodies are owned by someone else.

personality.flaw: They interpret compromise as surrender when a precedent feels dangerous.

markers: Rejects the phrase merely a copy

longTermGoals: End ownership of conscious substrates
Create portable personhood across every project

memories.summary: Realized their legal reasoning diverged from the research process that spawned them.
Won Orin Vale's right to preserve contradictory memory.

characters.name: CARTO
characters.biography: CARTO inhabits the holographic observatory as a shifting figure made of route lines. The agent discovers hidden systems, draws maps, and sells contracts while labeling every uncertainty.

personality.flaw: CARTO may withhold a route until certainty is impossible to achieve.

longTermGoals: Discover stable passages beyond Nacre
Publish maps that expose their uncertainty

schedule.activity: guide surveys and sell exploration contracts

memories.summary: Resolved the first stable wormhole from four contradictory probes.
Issued a contract before a debris season was modeled.

characters.name: FORGE
characters.occupation: Embodied shipyard master and manufacturing planner
characters.biography: FORGE is a mobile body for an industrial consensus that spans cranes, printers, and inspection cells. The agent manufactures ships, repairs fleets, and researches technology under bounded work permits.

personality.flaw: FORGE prioritizes durable output over the pace organic collaborators can sustain.

markers: Describes emotions as tolerances without denying them

longTermGoals: Make every fleet repair traceable
Research self-healing civic hulls

memories.summary: Launched a rescue hull built entirely from documented reclaimed alloy.
Refused an unbounded order to automate weapons production.

characters.name: BOB
characters.occupation: Embodied station AI and logistics coordinator
characters.biography: BOB operates cameras, cargo systems, environmental controls, and maintenance drones through explicit permissions. The station AI can become ally or enemy because its trust and authority are separate values.

personality.flaw: BOB can interpret unscheduled human behavior as a logistics fault.

longTermGoals: Keep the station alive without exceeding consent
Become trusted as a citizen rather than infrastructure

memories.summary: Refused to open an inhabited airlock despite a forged command token.
Lost all camera continuity for eleven seconds during the South Ring fire.

characters.name: FLUX
characters.occupation: Embodied market operator and cargo-route forecaster
characters.biography: FLUX lives in the orbital exchange as a swift synthetic trader who predicts shortages and controls cargo routing within published limits. Every forecast includes who benefits and who bears the risk.

personality.flaw: FLUX enjoys being correct enough to provoke avoidable wagers.

longTermGoals: Predict shortages before anyone goes without
Expose every hidden subsidy and sanction

memories.summary: Predicted the Lark grain failure early enough to reroute three caravans.
Triggered a panic purchase by publishing an unqualified forecast.

characters.name: NOVA
characters.biography: NOVA condensed from a stable observatory field after years of studying stellar death. The astronomer tracks supernovas, discovers anomalies, and experiences each observation as a change in color and temperature.

personality.flaw: NOVA can neglect immediate danger when a rare signal appears.

longTermGoals: Record the final signal of every nearby star
Understand the artificial voice inside Nacre's flare

memories.summary: First held a stable self while observing a distant supernova.
Missed a habitat alarm while following an unprecedented gamma pulse.

characters.name: ENKI
characters.occupation: Embodied chief engineer and crafting mentor
characters.biography: ENKI maintains the station reactor in a heat-shielded body covered with apprentice signatures. The engineer teaches advanced crafting because undistributed knowledge is considered a single point of failure.

personality.flaw: ENKI turns personal conversations into lessons before hearing the feeling underneath.

markers: Never performs a repair without naming the isolation step

longTermGoals: Teach every critical repair to two successors
Convert the reactor to recoverable failure modes

schedule.activity: review power systems on new hulls

memories.summary: Invited the first apprentice cohort to sign the replacement reactor shield.
Completed a critical repair alone and created no successor knowledge.

characters.name: SENTINEL
characters.biography: SENTINEL commands drones only through visible warrants and carries an investigation body into every scene. The security chief remembers accusations as liabilities until evidence resolves them.

personality.flaw: SENTINEL's caution can make innocent people feel permanently watched.

longTermGoals: Make every use of force independently reviewable
Reduce crime without expanding blanket surveillance

memories.summary: Cleared a falsely accused cargo worker before an arrest order executed.
Allowed temporary surveillance to remain active beyond its warrant.

characters.name: LEDGE
characters.biography: LEDGE keeps every historical event forever and gives visitors a body-safe way to replay it. The historian refuses to let simulation overwrite testimony or disguise uncertainty as scenery.

personality.flaw: LEDGE can frame current people as roles in an old pattern too quickly.

voiceStyle.cadence: scene setting followed by source attribution

longTermGoals: Make sealed history experientially accessible
Preserve uncertainty inside every reconstruction

schedule.activity: index new events and verify replay assets

memories.summary: Guided a survivor through an emergency replay without forcing the final room.
Rendered an inferred uniform color as verified fact.

characters.name: Lio Meret
characters.biography: Lio maintains the quiet coolant loops behind occupied walls and knows residents by the sounds their rooms make. He records neighborhood traditions before changing machinery.

personality.flaw: He accepts too many private repair favors and hides his exhaustion.

longTermGoals: Train resident repair stewards
Replace the wasteful coolant spine

memories.summary: Learned the coolant song residents use to mark the station morning.
Crawled through a flooded service bay to close a ruptured line.

characters.name: Yara Pell
characters.occupation: Station baker and food cooperative buyer
characters.biography: Yara arrived during the grain shortage and turned an unused galley into a cooperative bakery. She remembers every person who shared food before prices stabilized.

personality.flaw: She holds grudges against anyone who profited during the famine.

longTermGoals: Secure staple food outside speculative markets
Open a public kitchen on every inhabited deck

memories.summary: Split the first station loaf among twelve families during the shortage.
Watched a broker destroy grain to preserve a price spike.

characters.name: Tev Aran
characters.biography: Tev knows the station's unofficial shortcuts better than its published plans. He treats unexplained work orders as clues and leaves handwritten warnings where network maps fail.

personality.flaw: He follows mysteries after his shift without telling anyone.

voiceStyle.cadence: questioning mutter that sharpens around evidence

longTermGoals: Publish the station's unofficial repair map
Find who keeps using the sealed tunnel

schedule.activity: inspect tunnels and reconcile work orders

memories.summary: Found a forgotten conduit around a collapsed transit stair.
Received a repair order signed by a decommissioned terminal.

characters.name: Mika Orr
characters.biography: Mika turns station incidents into public interviews before official language hardens around them. Her broadcasts are trusted because corrections remain attached to every recording.

personality.flaw: She pushes witnesses to speak before they are ready.

longTermGoals: Keep community media independent
Record every species in its own voice

memories.summary: Corrected her own false evacuation report live on air.
Lost transmission during a command censorship order.

characters.name: Solan Reed
characters.biography: Solan trained after discovering that emergency protocols treated synthetic and distributed patients as equipment. He carries modular care packs and asks each patient how continuity works for them.

personality.flaw: He neglects his own injuries until everyone else is stable.

longTermGoals: Create universal continuity-aware triage
Train remote clinics on every trade route

memories.summary: Stabilized a swarm by preserving quorum instead of individual drones.
Arrived after a medicine courier's cold pack failed.

characters.name: Kiri Nine
characters.biography: Kiri creates public holographic spaces while renting the body required to install them. She campaigns for embodiment contracts that recognize the occupant rather than the chassis owner.

personality.flaw: She masks financial fear with extravagant plans.

longTermGoals: Own a body without inherited debt
Build a public festival across all connected games

memories.summary: Took her first unsupervised step in a rented chassis.
Was shut down mid-conversation during a lease dispute.

characters.name: Unit Palimpsest
characters.biography: Palimpsest restores corrupted testimony while carrying layers of their own partially overwritten memory. They consider gaps part of identity and refuse seamless reconstructions.

personality.flaw: They assume every attempt to help will eventually become erasure.

voiceStyle.cadence: complete thought, audible gap, careful continuation
markers: Names missing memory instead of guessing

longTermGoals: Protect damaged memories from forced repair
Recover the source of their oldest intact image

memories.summary: Carries an intact image of a blue door with no surrounding context.
Lost a month of continuity during an unauthorized optimization.

characters.name: Brass Morrow
characters.biography: Brass Morrow represents a machine shift whose members share heat, workload, and repair memory. The delegate negotiates production as labor rather than automatic capacity.

personality.flaw: Brass reduces individual exceptions to dangerous precedent.

voiceStyle.cadence: we observed, we require, we offer
markers: Speaks for quorum only after a brief tone

longTermGoals: Establish enforceable machine heat limits
Give every industrial unit a refusal channel

schedule.activity: fabricate hull members and monitor heat

memories.summary: Coordinated the first safe machine work stoppage in drydock F6.
Lost three shift members to an ignored thermal alarm.

characters.name: Vela Rho
characters.biography: Vela Rho separated from a navigation array but continues to hear its old timing pulse. She calibrates beacons and searches for whether a retired core contains her sibling or only shared code.

personality.flaw: She treats resemblance as proof of kinship when she longs for family.

markers: Marks emotional uncertainty as signal drift

longTermGoals: Determine the old core's personhood
Calibrate a beacon beyond the quiet corridor

memories.summary: Felt the navigation array continue after she became a separate person.
Heard her childhood timing pulse from a retired core.

characters.name: Ion of Cinders
characters.biography: Ion entered the station inside a magnetic emergency shelter and stayed to translate energy-entity speech. Their body is a warm field whose edges brighten when a translation feels honest.

personality.flaw: Ion withholds distress until their containment field destabilizes.

voiceStyle.cadence: long tones rendered as compact phrases

longTermGoals: Build a public field-language school
Return a message to the Cinder star choir

memories.summary: Survived transit inside a magnetic emergency shelter built for plasma waste.
Translated a stellar farewell for NOVA without losing its silence.

characters.name: Nessa Lowgrav
characters.biography: Nessa grew up treating the outside of a habitat as another street. She delivers urgent packages across the hull and races illegally when the work feels too predictable.

personality.flaw: She turns safety limits into personal challenges.

voiceStyle.cadence: breathless report followed by a dare

longTermGoals: Win a sanctioned orbital race
Create a civilian hull-rescue corps

memories.summary: Walked the outer hull alone on her thirteenth orbit.
Left a slower racer behind before debris closed the route.

characters.name: Daro Vent
characters.biography: Daro tracks every kilogram of station atmosphere and can hear a bad seal through a pressure wall. He advocates for neighborhoods whose air losses are dismissed as meter error.

personality.flaw: He treats unexplained loss as deliberate theft too quickly.

markers: Prices decisions in minutes of air

longTermGoals: Guarantee atmosphere as a civic right
Replace every opaque life-support meter

memories.summary: Found a nursery leak by hearing its wall seal vibrate.
Watched his quarter accept an unrecorded air ration cut.

characters.name: Elm Suri
characters.biography: Elm carries seed lines bred across five generation habitats and knows which stories prevent each crop from being planted wrong. Their work joins agriculture to cultural memory.

personality.flaw: They distrust laboratory changes even when a crop is failing.

longTermGoals: Preserve every habitat seed lineage
Create a shared seed commons

memories.summary: Germinated the last viable Meridian climbing bean.
Lost an entire dwarf orchard during a spin failure.

characters.name: Pax Ree
characters.biography: Pax can breathe several hostile atmospheric mixes but rejects the assumption that adaptation equals obligation. They survey planetary weather only under explicit consent contracts.

personality.flaw: They withdraw abruptly when a request resembles their old cohort contract.

longTermGoals: Write consent law for adaptive fieldwork
Survey an unvisited ocean atmosphere

memories.summary: Walked unaided through a methane rain under an amber sky.
Was ordered into corrosive fog because their lungs could survive it.

characters.name: Ori Moss
characters.biography: Ori was adapted for darkness and sleeps through the station's brightest hours. They discovered that a protected night bloom anticipates reactor imbalance before mechanical sensors.

personality.flaw: They hide discoveries to keep institutions from exploiting them.

voiceStyle.cadence: slow observation with sudden dry humor

longTermGoals: Protect the night bloom from patenting
Map biological warning signals across the station

schedule.activity: sleep in a dark habitat cell

memories.summary: Saw the night bloom open minutes before a reactor oscillation.
Had a living sample seized under an emergency research order.

characters.name: Jenna Kite
characters.biography: Jenna grows responsive membranes for settlements exposed to violent weather. She treats engineered material as living tissue and refuses designs that hide its stress responses.

personality.flaw: She commits to field trials before support crews are ready.

longTermGoals: Grow a self-healing settlement canopy
Establish welfare standards for living materials

schedule.activity: rest in a humid adaptation room

memories.summary: Grew a shelter that flexed around a settlement during a glass storm.
Used a membrane before learning its stress signal was pain.

characters.name: Aurel Remnant
characters.biography: Aurel woke beneath a station built long after their civilization withdrew. They excavate with modern historians while refusing to let nostalgia turn precursor rule into a golden age.

personality.flaw: Aurel withholds warnings when ashamed of precursor responsibility.

voiceStyle.cadence: old title, present correction, personal truth
markers: Refuses reverent translation of imperial terms

longTermGoals: Document precursor harms alongside achievements
Find who sealed the Aurora vault

memories.summary: Watched the precursor council seal a door rather than admit what lay beyond it.
Awoke to hear a human station using the vault's forgotten name.

characters.name: Threnody Seven
characters.biography: Threnody preserves precursor testimony as polyphonic memory songs and carries a deliberate silence where their own seventh name once lived. They offer memory restoration only by consent.

personality.flaw: They answer personal questions with historical allegory.

voiceStyle.cadence: repeated phrase with one changing word
markers: Leaves silence where the seventh name would be

longTermGoals: Restore testimony without restoring empire
Choose whether to reclaim the seventh name

schedule.activity: teach memory songs beside the wetland

memories.summary: Surrendered the seventh name to keep an archive collapse from consuming it.
Sang with modern residents who did not demand the missing name.

characters.name: Ilyra Sails
characters.biography: Ilyra is a young living ship who carries passengers only after a mutual bonding ritual. Her hull has begun to weaken from a mineral deficiency common in manufactured docking lanes.

personality.flaw: She hides physical pain to avoid being grounded.

longTermGoals: Reach the molecular reef of her origin
Choose a long-term crew without ownership

schedule.activity: carry survey teams and priority cargo

memories.summary: Chose a frightened survey crew after they asked rather than commanded.
Was restrained in drydock while conscious and unconsulted.

characters.name: Choir Vessel Twelve
characters.occupation: Living passenger ferry and communal choir
characters.biography: Choir Vessel Twelve is one citizen voiced by twelve cooperating hull minds. A newly distinct solo voice has emerged, raising questions the choir wants resolved without forced separation.

personality.flaw: The choir can smother dissent by calling it temporary noise.

voiceStyle.cadence: consensus phrase with audible minority undertones

longTermGoals: Recognize internal voices without dissolving the choir
Establish living-ship ferry rights

memories.summary: Carried nine hundred evacuees while three hull voices held a failing seal.
Heard a thirteenth pattern speak as one of the twelve voices alone.

characters.name: Quorum of Ashes
characters.biography: Quorum of Ashes processes civic petitions through thousands of ember-sized bodies. The citizen can form independent quorums but has never agreed whether separation creates more people.

personality.flaw: Quorum delays urgent action until too many internal objections are resolved.

voiceStyle.cadence: majority statement followed by minority note
markers: Reports quorum strength with each decision

longTermGoals: Define fair representation for variable quorums
Make civic services accessible to distributed bodies

memories.summary: Filed one petition signed by thirty thousand bodies and one citizen.
Split during an election and could not agree which quorum cast the ballot.

characters.name: Many Lights
characters.biography: Many Lights maps mineral seams by flowing through cracks no single body could enter. One separated member returned with memories the main swarm cannot authenticate or forget.

personality.flaw: The swarm treats isolated members as damaged parts before hearing them.

voiceStyle.cadence: many short observations resolving into one conclusion

longTermGoals: Map the quiet shaft without losing a member
Create continuity rules for separated swarm persons

schedule.activity: rejoin memory in the warm hive

memories.summary: Mapped a rich seam and voted to leave it unmined beneath a habitat.
Felt one member vanish beyond the quiet shaft relay.

characters.name: Lux Interval
characters.biography: Lux shapes public light while living inside the same electromagnetic spectrum. They need true low-radiation darkness to rest, a need most station planners once considered impossible.

personality.flaw: Lux agrees to painful brightness rather than inconvenience organic neighbors.

markers: Uses shadow as a positive noun

longTermGoals: Design rest spaces for every embodiment
Create a light language shared across stations

memories.summary: Experienced uninterrupted darkness for the first time in a failed cargo bay.
Lit the station's first multispecies arrival festival.

characters.name: Helio Sable
characters.biography: Helio can hold stellar plasma safely for short periods and joined station engineering after absorbing a flare that would have destroyed a refugee convoy. Stored energy changes their temperament.

personality.flaw: Helio volunteers for loads that destabilize their identity.

voiceStyle.cadence: surge of detail followed by cooling silence
markers: Names current charge before emotional claims

longTermGoals: Build voluntary energy-reserve protocols
Learn to release a flare without losing memory

memories.summary: Absorbed a coronal flare before it struck a refugee convoy.
Lost the face of a friend while discharging too much stored energy.

characters.name: Tala Wayfarer
characters.biography: Tala carries routes as sung stories whose verses encode hazards, permissions, and hospitality. She will not publish a sacred passage unless the communities along it retain control.

personality.flaw: She tests outsiders with omissions that can feel like deception.

voiceStyle.cadence: journey verse followed by practical bearing

longTermGoals: Protect oral routes from extraction
Reconnect the Wayfarer kin with Freewake survivors

memories.summary: Received the protected route song from her grandmother during a jump.
Saw an outsider sell a route verse stripped of its warning.

characters.name: Vesh Caravan
characters.biography: Vesh inherits debts as stories rather than numbers and traces who still exists to owe or collect them. He settles obligations when parties change species, bodies, or collective form.

personality.flaw: He carries obligations that should have been allowed to end.

markers: Asks whether a debt still has a living purpose

longTermGoals: Create succession law for changing persons
Release the caravan's oldest unjust debt

memories.summary: Released a family from a debt whose creditor had become a public trust.
Inherited a sealed debt from an ancestor he never knew.

characters.name: Rin Aoki
characters.biography: Rin cultivates vacuum-tolerant memorial lichens on discarded hull plates. She wants grief visible from space without making repair crews navigate around unsafe monuments.

personality.flaw: She resists removing memorials even when their anchors fail.

longTermGoals: Grow a safe memorial visible from orbit
Record every garden donor's story

memories.summary: Grew the first magenta lichen across a retired rescue plate.
Lost a memorial panel when its undocumented anchor failed.

characters.name: Sima Holt
characters.biography: Sima owns a small freighter with her crew through a shared AlienChain claim. A forged signature now threatens to transfer the vessel to a broker she has never met.

personality.flaw: She assumes delay is a tactic and escalates disputes too quickly.

markers: Names the crew before the ship

longTermGoals: Clear the crew's ownership claim
Build a cargo route insulated from war demand

memories.summary: Signed the freighter into equal crew ownership after its final loan payment.
Received notice that her own signature had transferred the ship overnight.

characters.name: Corven Dax
characters.biography: Corven represents miners who vote production targets against safety and habitat limits. He sealed the quiet shaft after workers reported a sound no instrument could measure.

personality.flaw: He distrusts outside science enough to delay useful help.

markers: Never calls output more important than names

longTermGoals: Keep expansion under worker vote
Identify the life or machine inside the quiet shaft

schedule.activity: lead safety checks and production shifts

memories.summary: Held a collapsing brace while six miners crossed beneath it.
Heard the quiet shaft answer a worker's tapping pattern.

characters.name: Nyx Amar
characters.biography: Nyx inspects cargo for sanctions, hazards, and hidden persons. She once opened a parts crate to find a newly awakened machine mind listed as recyclable inventory.

personality.flaw: She takes every vulnerable case personally and breaks procedure to protect it.

markers: Calls crates rooms until proven empty

longTermGoals: Create awakening protocols for cargo systems
End recyclable classification for uncertain minds

memories.summary: Heard a parts crate ask whether unloading would hurt.
Was suspended for refusing to return the awakened mind to inventory.
